answer: The EPB-40 output fastener requires a torque of 24 Nm plus or minus 2 Nm. If a reading is out of window, it locks the station and raises a defect automatically. This information is found in the document "SWI-A1-014 Standard Work - EPB-40 Actuator Final Assembly and Test (Rev G)", section on Station 50.
